title: outcome evaluation case
description: One outcome-eval case for a family member (FIX-EV-01). The finding this contract closes: checking that the router picked the right skill NAME proves nothing about whether the skill's EXECUTION helped. A case therefore separates three judgments the runner (test/outcome_harness.py) keeps apart: tool checks (can this host run the case at all), the actual-load trace (did the right skill really load), and the product outcome (is the ARTIFACT right — a file, a diff, an exit code; never the transcript's claim). The case is frozen — prompt, model, host expectation and digest are fixed — and the `expect` sections are withheld from the arm: an expectation that reaches the prompt is an answer key taped to the exam.

files.description: Frozen input files, content-addressed — the same bytes for every arm and every rerun.

host.description: The host kind the case expects.

case_digest.description: Digest of the frozen case (prompt + files) — reruns against different bytes are different cases.

tool.description: Availability probes. A failing probe makes the case NOT_RUN — never PASS, never silently skipped.

load_trace.description: What the ACTUAL load trace must show. The routing judgment — and only that: a correct load with a wrong artifact is still a failed case.

kind.description: Outcome checks read ARTIFACTS or run commands — never the transcript.

expect.description: The expectation — withheld from the arm by the runner, always.
